answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 6 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in plume, verified in falcon, and delta names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 14 hours of verification and 1 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
